method: Each row's official source page was fetched again on the verification date. Price, karat, title, metal and any published weight were read from that page and compared with the stored value. A stored value that could not be reproduced on the live official page is replaced by the observed value (or blanked if the page no longer shows it) and flagged. Nothing is inferred.
